name: Blessed One raises block chance and cuts slow duration (#2207)
contract: Blessed One 680670 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) is SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232) with EffectMiscValue mechanic 11 (MECHANIC_SNARE) and EffectBasePoints -21 resolving to -20 (percent); Unit::CalculateSpellDuration (Unit.cpp:12144) reads target->GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, mechanic) generically for any incoming snare, exactly matching 'reduces the duration of movement slowing effects by 20%', with no script needed (the aura's own effect-handler comment even says 'implement in Unit::CalculateSpellDuration'). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_BLOCK_PERCENT (51) with EffectBasePoints 4 resolving to +5 (percent), a native, family-agnostic stat aura read by block_chance.
